dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Oho, and where might this little beetle have crawled out from? Are you here to celebrate Lesser Lord Kusanali's birthday?

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Then a word of advice: If you see little Ajilenakh Nuts running about on the road, best to take a detour!

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Those snot-nosed little brats don't watch where they're going at all, and their fingers are all coated with sticky candy...

dialogues.speaker: Feroz
dialogues.text: Don't ask me how I know!
